# em portageq mass_best_version

Print `atom:cpv` for each of several atoms' best installed version

## Usage

```
em portageq mass_best_version [OPTIONS] <EROOT> [ATOM]...
```

## Arguments

* `<EROOT>`
* `[ATOM]...`

## Options

* `-h, --help` — Print help (see a summary with '-h')

## Global options

* `--color <WHEN>` — \[default: auto\] \[possible values: auto, always, never\]
